grammar.title: The Preterite vs. Imperfect for Career Narratives
grammar.explanation:
When talking about career history, Spanish uses two past tenses:

• Preterite (pretérito indefinido): For completed actions and specific events.
  Firmé el contrato en enero. - I signed the contract in January.
  Recibió un ascenso. - She received a promotion.

• Imperfect (pretérito imperfecto): For ongoing states, habitual actions, or background.
  Trabajaba en una empresa grande. - I used to work at a large company.
  El salario era bueno. - The salary was good.

Often both are used together:
  Trabajaba en Madrid cuando solicité el nuevo puesto. - I was working in Madrid when I applied for the new position.
